theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pc_piece_multiplicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → ℤ), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → InjOn H B → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → Measurable g → IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ)) B → (∀ u ∈ B, g u ≠ 0) → ∃ m : Euclid P → ℝ, Measurable m ∧ (∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, m y = z) ∧ (∀ u ∈ B, m (H u) = g u) ∧ μHE[n] (H '' B) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∫⁻ y in H '' B, ‖m y‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ∫⁻ u in B, ‖(g u : ℝ)‖ₑ
